ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper part of the figure is a transition-state structure, with one benzene ring on the left and one on the right. The left benzene ring is connected to an alkenyl side chain; the side chain contains one C=C and continues to connect to a central carbon. This central carbon is also connected to the right benzene ring and to the upper CO2H group. NH2 is attached below the left benzene ring. There is also an O=N-O-N=O fragment at the bottom of the figure, and arrows and dashed transition-state markings are drawn. Reasoning count: According to the problem, exclude all bonds involving hydrogen, and ignore arrows and dashed transition-state markings. The left benzene ring is counted as 6 bonds according to the number of intraring heavy-atom connections; the right benzene ring is also counted as 6 bonds. Heavy-atom bonds in the side chain include: 1 from the left benzene ring to the vinyl carbon, 1 C=C, 1 from the central carbon to the right benzene ring, and 1 from the central carbon to the carboxyl carbon, for a total of 4. Inside CO2H, only heavy-atom bonds are counted, namely C=O and C-O, for a total of 2, not counting O-H. The C-N bond from the left benzene ring to NH2 is counted as 1, not counting N-H. In the lower O=N-O-N=O fragment, there are 4 bonds: O=N, N-O, O-N, and N=O. Total = 6 + 6 + 4 + 2 + 1 + 4 = 23.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Count bonds fragment by fragment from the image. Count 6 bonds in the left benzene ring and 6 in the right benzene ring. Count the side-chain heavy-atom bonds: left phenyl-to-vinyl carbon, the C=C bond, central carbon-to-right phenyl, and central carbon-to-carboxyl carbon. Count the two internal CO2H heavy-atom bonds, the left ring-to-NH2 bond, and the four bonds in the lower O=N-O-N=O fragment. Exclude the N-H/O-H bonds and ignore the arrows/dashed transition-state markings. Add these counts to get 23.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中上方是一个过渡态结构，左侧和右侧各有一个苯环。左苯环连着一段烯基侧链，侧链中有一个 C=C，继续连接到一个中心碳；该中心碳还连接右侧苯环和上方的 CO2H 基团。左苯环下方连有 NH2。图的下方还有一个 O=N-O-N=O 片段，并画有箭头和虚线过渡态标记。

推理计数：按题意排除所有涉及氢的键，并忽略箭头和虚线过渡态标记。左侧苯环按环内重原子连接数计 6 个键；右侧苯环也计 6 个键。侧链重原子键包括：左苯环到乙烯基碳 1 个、C=C 1 个、中心碳到右苯环 1 个、中心碳到羧基碳 1 个，共 4 个。CO2H 内部只数重原子键，即 C=O 和 C-O，共 2 个，不数 O-H。左苯环到 NH2 的 C-N 键计 1 个，不数 N-H。下方 O=N-O-N=O 片段中有 O=N、N-O、O-N、N=O 共 4 个键。总数 = 6 + 6 + 4 + 2 + 1 + 4 = 23。
